definitions: A city in Mali, West Africa, situated on the southern edge of the Sahara Desert.
Historically, a major centre of Islamic scholarship and trade on the trans-Saharan caravan routes.
Figuratively, a remote or faraway place.
examples: He dreamed of travelling to Timbuktu.
The ancient manuscripts of Timbuktu are invaluable.
It felt like we were in Timbuktu, so far from civilisation.
